marketing_description: The Makita XTS02Z LXT Series Brushless Cordless Stapler drives standard 18 gauge 1/4 inch narrow crown staples from 3/8 inch to 1-1/2 inch. It features a spring-loaded driving mechanism and tool-less depth adjustment for precise flush and countersink nailing. This stapler is designed for use with an 18V LXT 5.0Ah battery.
